concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-methods-ach]] - ACH Direct Debit merchant eligibility, required bank-account verification, delayed batch settlement and late-return exposure, conflicting void guidance, and bank-account vaulting versus recurring-billing boundary
warnings: Treat the 2026-09-16 page as collected snapshot evidence, not confirmation of current availability, merchant enablement or buyer eligibility.
Preserve the internal void-guidance conflict: the page says ACH cannot be voided, then says support can enable voiding in circumstances with a variable timeline.
Do not treat Settled status or disbursement as irreversible; the page documents returns after the ordinary three-business-day window.
Keep ACH Direct Debit distinct from SEPA Direct Debit, cards, wallets and sibling bank-payment methods.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-methods-ach]] - Braintree ACH bank-account vaulting with the page's explicit boundary that Braintree recurring billing does not support repeat payments with bank accounts
warnings: Keep this limitation scoped to Braintree recurring billing and the collected ACH guide; do not generalize it to all bank-account payment products or external recurring-payment systems.
Do not infer current support or future roadmap from the collected page's current-tense wording.
